'''Maccer''' (born 1965 in Salford, [[United Kingdom]]) is a character in the [[3D Universe]] who appears as a minor character in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]. Maccer is the lead singer of the [[Gurning Chimps]] and is on his first tour of America. He is voiced by [[Shaun Ryder]].<ref name="Shaun Ryder casting">{{cite web | url = http://www.imdb.com/title/tt0383385/fullcredits#cast | title = Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas page| work = Internet Movie Database | accessdate = | accessyear = }}</ref> Maccer maintains a website, http://www.maccer.net.  

==Character history==
===Early life===
Born in Salford in 1965, Maccer broke into the music scene in an unknown year.  He invented a musical style that became known as "EXTREMELY BAGGY", and became notorious for his hard partying lifestyle, usage of drugs and self abuse, and for breaking musical taboos. This lifestyle would leave Maccer with a stuttering voice and hypersexuality in the form of compulsive masturbation. Forming a band called the Gurning Chimps under the management of a man named Pabsy, the Chimps embarked on a world tour.  At some point during the tour, Pabsy vanished and the band ended up under the management of [[Kent Paul]], who took them to America.

===GTA San Andreas===
Paul hooked the Chimps up with a local drug dealer named [[The Truth]], who took the band into the [[Bone County]] desert on a "[[Don Peyote|peyote safari]]". The trip went bad, with The Truth waking up separated from the band in a [[Los Santos in GTA III Era|Los Santos]] Japanese bathhouse.  Later, The Truth asks his friend, protagonist [[Carl Johnson|Carl "CJ" Johnson]] to go find them out on [[Arco del Oeste]], but by the time Carl found them, the other members of the Chimps had vanished, leaving Paul and Maccer behind. Carl takes Paul and Maccer looking for the rest of the Chimps, but after a close encounter with some angry snake farmers and no sign of the other Chimps, Paul decides to simply "pray they made it back to civilization", saying that "keyboardists and drummers are ten-a-penny anyway".  

Paul asks Carl to drive them to [[Las Venturas]], where his old friend, disbarred former lawyer [[Ken Rosenberg|Ken "Rosie" Rosenberg]], is involved in running Caligula's Palace, a renowned mob casino, owned by three feuding Mafia families, with Rosie set as a neutral party. Paul and Maccer are taken hostage by Leone family don and surviving mob boss [[Salvatore Leone]] to ensure Rosie's cooperation. When Salvatore asks Carl to perform a hit on Saint Mark's Bistro in Liberty City, Carl tricks Salvatore into letting Rosie, Paul and Maccer go with him as backup. Instead of actually taking them, he has them leave for Los Santos. 

On arriving in Los Santos, Paul and Maccer stay in recovering rapper [[Madd Dogg's Crib]] as Carl's guest for the remainder of the storyline, later appearing in the final cutscene on an occasion of celebration.

===After 1992===
After the events of San Andreas, Maccer found the other members of The Gurning Chimps and carried on with a world tour. He was later banned from Australia<ref name="Maccer rumors">{{cite web | url = http://www.maccer.net/ | title = Maccer.net (Rumors tab)| work = [[Rockstar Games]] | accessdate = | accessyear = }}</ref> and went into rehab, using the [[Epsilon Program]].<ref name="Maccer rumors">{{cite web | url = http://www.maccer.net/ | title = Maccer.net (Rumors tab)| work = [[Rockstar Games]] | accessdate = | accessyear = }}</ref> Maccer’s career was effectively stopped during this period due to a series of legal battles, including one lasting seven years,<ref name="Maccer Music">{{cite web | url = http://www.maccer.net/ | title = Maccer.net (Music tab)| work = [[Rockstar Games]] | accessdate = | accessyear = }}</ref> limiting the use of songs by the Gurning Chimps. In 2004, Maccer began planning a come back tour.<ref name="Come back tour">{{cite web | url = http://www.maccer.net/ | title = Maccer.net (Come Back Tour tab)| work = [[Rockstar Games]] | accessdate = | accessyear = }}</ref>

==Trivia==
*During the mission [[Don Peyote]] if the player waits long enough Maccer will say he has to use the bathroom, and will then get out and urinate. A small animation will be shown before he gets back in the car.
*According to a cut line, Paul says that Maccer is [[wp:Priapism|priapic]]; a syndrome where an erection lasts for several hours, or even days. This condition is actually very painful and if the blood making the erection doesn't flow back into the body it will stagnate and make matters worse. Priapism can be very common with individuals who have done narcotics such as Cocaine and other blood pressure raising drugs like it. However, this may just be Paul's way of sarcastically insulting Maccer.
*During [[Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories]], [[Head Radio]] DJ [[Michael Hunt]] mentions that he was at a backstage party for the Gurning Chimps, during which Maccer went sick on his shoes.
